evals.name: generate-default-4
evals.prompt: /ABC the hero CTA button feels weak - make it more prominent
evals.expected_output: Four genuinely different CTA variations (A-D), scoped under [data-abc-scope="hero"][data-abc] with id-tagged ABC:hero:* fenced markers, plus the section-scoped switcher (appears only when the hero section is in view; ?abc-hero= deep link; per-path+id localStorage). Reply lists one line per letter.
expectations: The hero section is tagged data-abc-scope and its switcher button is fixed bottom-left
The switcher appears only while the hero section is in view and is hidden when scrolled away
Clicking the switcher cycles through exactly 4 distinct hero-CTA states and wraps back to the first
A ?abc-hero=<letter> URL parameter deep-links to that variation on load
Every experiment addition is fenced with balanced ABC:hero:* markers; no global html[data-abc]
The chat reply describes each lettered variation in one line

evals.name: generate-count-6
evals.prompt: /ABC 6 try bolder takes on the hero cta button
evals.expected_output: Six section-scoped variations (A-F) with the switcher cycling all six, ?abc-hero= deep link, balanced ABC:hero:* fences for every letter, reply listing one line per letter.
expectations: The switcher cycles through exactly 6 distinct hero-CTA states and wraps back to the first
The six variations restyle the CTA in visibly different ways
Balanced ABC:hero:* fences cover letters A-F and the widget config lists all six
The chat reply describes each of the six lettered variations in one line

evals.name: iterate-target-b
evals.prompt: in the hero one, B move the cta button 10px lower
evals.expected_output: A 10px downward offset added ONLY inside the hero experiment's B fenced block. Hero A/C/D, the hero base block, the pricing experiment and both widgets stay byte-identical. Reply signs off 'hero B' before the color emoji.
expectations: In hero variation B the CTA renders exactly 10px lower than in the original fixture
Hero variations A, C, D and the entire pricing experiment render identical to the fixture
Outside the ABC:hero:B fenced block the file is byte-identical to the fixture
The chat reply signs off with the current section+letter (hero B) before the color emoji

evals.name: add-second-experiment
evals.prompt: /ABC 3 give me three takes on the pricing button
evals.expected_output: A second, independent pricing experiment (A-C) added beside the already-live hero experiment: pricing section tagged data-abc-scope, id-tagged ABC:pricing:* markers, a second widget copy. Hero experiment untouched; the two switchers gate by section and stack instead of overlapping.
expectations: The page now has two section-scoped experiments (hero + pricing) and the manager tracks both
Each section's button appears only when that section is in view; others are hidden
When two sections are on screen at once, the buttons stack instead of overlapping
Clicking one section's switcher changes only that section's variant, never the other's
Markers are id-tagged and balanced per experiment, one widget fence per id, no global html[data-abc]

evals.name: finalize-one-of-two
evals.prompt: the hero cta - C is the winner. save it and remove its little switcher. leave the pricing experiment exactly as it is.
evals.expected_output: Hero winner C folded into the section (its rules collapsed to the section's own selector, hard-shadow lift kept), all ABC:hero:* markers / data-abc-scope="hero" / hero widget / loser elements deleted, and the pricing experiment left fully live and switchable.
expectations: The hero experiment is fully removed (no ABC:hero markers, scope attribute, widget, or loser elements)
The hero CTA permanently shows variant C's look with no switching
Only the pricing switcher remains on the page; the hero button is gone
The pricing experiment is untouched and still cycles A->B->C live
The page loads with no console errors
